Hi Alex / Acme scheduling team,

Thanks for the quick sync yesterday. Per our call, the goal is a 90-minute technical deep-dive where our SE (Monica) and your architecture team (including Yoko in Tokyo) can validate integration surface and perf expectations. Because teams are spread across US / EU / APAC, I pulled a few candidate windows that try to balance morning/evening friction.

Attached: proposed_slots.ics (calendar file) and deepdive-agenda-v1.pdf

Options (all times below include UTC conversion) — please tell us which one works or suggest alternatives: 
- Option A: 2027-09-15 15:00–16:30 UTC (US Pacific: 08:00–09:30 PDT / UK: 16:00–17:30 BST / Tokyo: 00:00–01:30 JST next day)
- Option B: 2027-09-15 18:00–19:30 UTC (US Pacific: 11:00–12:30 PDT / UK: 19:00–20:30 BST / Tokyo: 03:00–04:30 JST next day)
- Option C: 2027-09-16 06:00–07:30 UTC (US Pacific: 23:00–00:30 PDT previous day / UK: 07:00–08:30 BST / Tokyo: 15:00–16:30 JST)

Notes: 
- The US is still on DST (PDT) through early November; EU switches are already applied (BST). I flagged Option C as slightly more APAC-friendly (Tokyo afternoon) but it means late-night for some US participants.

If you prefer, we can do two shorter blocks (45 min) split across regions and hand off — mention if you want that approach.

Next step: if ops@acme can confirm a preference, Monica will lock the agenda items and we’ll circulate a final calendar invite with dial-in details and an “if node capacity constrained” fallback model variant to discuss.

Thanks,
